# Aurora

> Aurora compiles Beamer LaTeX decks (.tex) into single-file, manim-style animated HTML presentations. It supports written equations, animated plots with value trackers, histograms, equation morphs, and organic-chemistry mechanisms (SMILES molecules, curly arrows, mechanism transforms). Existing Beamer decks (overlays, columns, blocks, tables, TikZ) compile unchanged.

CLI: `aurora build|serve|check|snapshot|init|reference`. All machine-facing commands accept `--json`.

## Docs

- [README](README.md): overview, quick start, Beamer support, CLI
- [Deck-author guide for agents](templates/AGENTS.deck.md): the edit → check → snapshot loop, layout budget, scene and chemistry recipes, gotchas
- [Scene command reference](docs/REFERENCE.md): every command, key, type and default (also `aurora reference --json`)
- [Agent skill](skills/aurora-slides/SKILL.md): drop-in skill for Claude Code and other agents
- [Design](docs/DESIGN.md): architecture and step model
